name: 3D-Pic Maker
summary:
Your photos were never meant to stay flat. ✨

3D-Pic Maker turns any picture into a true spatial 3D scene. Lean in, step to the side, peek behind the subject, and the moment opens up around you like a window.

🧠 AI THAT RUNS ON YOUR HEADSET
▸ Depth Anything 3: state-of-the-art depth for crisp, natural 3D (optional max-quality mode)
▸ LaMa: repaints what was hidden behind people and objects, so the scene stays whole as you move
▸ Real-ESRGAN: restores detail and cleans up noise in small or old photos
▸ 🔒 1
